SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch...Sikhon,
REPORT
Dat. August 19, 1938.
Subject Shanghai Fish Peddlers' Mutual Help Association(上海市魚販互助會)-
Letter addressed to Shanghai Municipal Police in connection with
the increase in commission charged against fish peddlers by fish hongs.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih Forwarded by W.Kagan. O.J.L

With reference to the attached letter, enquiries have
been made with the following result:-
At the beginning of June, 1938, one Zau Er Chong(趙尔昌),
aged 40, native of Shaoshing, attempted to organize a so-called
"Shanghai Fish Peddlers' Delegation (上海市魚販代表團)" in a room
over the kitchen at No. 41 Avenue Foch, which is his home
address. In order to gain support from fish peddlers he
published a manifesto in the "Standard" newspaper of June 16
advocating a reduction in the commission charged to fish
peddlers by fish hongs. This attempt was however frustrated
by the French Police as soon as it was started.
On August 12, one named Wong(王 ), claiming to represent
Zau Er Chong whom he described as the Chairman of the "Shanghai
Fish Peddlers' Mutual Help Association"(上海市魚販互助會), called
at the Cold Storage Owners'Association, 123 Quai de France,
and requested Mr. Wang Tseng Se (黄振世), Chairman of the
Association, to earmark a certain amount from the funds
derived from the increase in commission for the disposal of
the "Shanghai Fish Peddlers' Mutual Help Association". This
request was rejected by Mr. Wang who does not recognize the
latter organization.
It appears that the so-called "Shanghai Fish Peddlers'
Mutual Help Association" is not supported by fish peddlers
and exists in name only.
Zau was formerly an executive member of the People's
Training Department of the former Shanghai Special District
Kuomintang Headquarters, but was dismissed in March, 1936,
owing to misconduct. Following his dismissal, Zau attempted
to organize local fish peddlers in conjunction with Woo Foo

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
特务科第1股...Sikhon，
报告
日期：1938年8月19日。
事由：上海市鱼贩互助会——
致上海公共租界工部局警务处的信函，涉及鱼行向鱼贩收取的佣金增加一事。
由警探潘连璧（Pan Lien Pih）呈报，经W. Kagan转呈。O.J.L

关于所附信函，经查询，结果如下：
1938年6月初，一名叫赵尔昌（Zau Er Chong），40岁，绍兴人，试图在其住所福煦路41号厨房楼上的一间房间内，组织一个所谓的“上海市鱼贩代表团”。为了争取鱼贩的支持，他在6月16日的《标准》（Standard）报上发表宣言，主张降低鱼行向鱼贩收取的佣金。然而，这一企图刚开始即被法租界巡捕房挫败。
8月12日，一名姓王（Wong）的人，声称代表被称为“上海市鱼贩互助会”主席的赵尔昌，前往法国大马路123号冷藏业主协会，请求该协会主席黄振世（Wang Tseng Se）先生从因佣金增加而获得的资金中拨出一定数额，供“上海市鱼贩互助会”支配。此请求被王先生拒绝，因其不承认该组织。
看来，所谓的“上海市鱼贩互助会”并未得到鱼贩的支持，仅存其名。
赵尔昌曾任前上海特别区国民党总部民众训练部的执行委员，但因行为不端于1936年3月被免职。被免职后，赵尔昌曾试图与伍福（Woo Foo，音译）联合组织当地鱼贩
